notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware is attached and no hardware or sim backend was run. The upstream PegInHoleGymEnv is a PyBullet/Gymnasium environment (rlenv.py:13); package code never imports or runs the clone, and pybullet plus the clone's URDF files are not installed where the gate runs. The fake backend is therefore the package's own pure Python kinematic stand-in (fake.py), not the PyBullet environment, and it was never compared with a real upstream run. The observation keeps the real 100x100x1 shape and count; the fake projects the hole and end effector into that image instead of rendering OpenGL. NOT COVERED: PyBullet rigid-body dynamics, inverse kinematics, contacts/table geometry, the camera render, actuator/sensor/noise models, wall-clock time and snapshots; the fidelity gaps list them. Five warnings are expected of this Gymnasium family driver and do not fail the gate: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only changes the next reset, so it makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for inputs the bridge derives (reset.seed, seed.seed, action.values[*], step.ticks); declaring actions to add units was not attempted because the exemplar shows it loses the bridge's descriptions. Only catalogue classes cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed (the report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
